evals.prompt: Use @ws-self-learning for a typical self-learning task in this project.
evals.expected_output: Agent loads ws-self-learning and follows its skill contract.
assertions: Follows skill steps and Done when criteria
Uses path tokens from tools.md instead of hardcoded consumer paths

evals.prompt: /self-learning — edge case: missing or incomplete config.json
evals.expected_output: Agent stops or bootstraps via configure-project/setup, not silent guessing.
assertions: Recognizes ws-self-learning trigger from slash or @ invocation
References ws-shared/config.json or configure-project when config missing
